verdict.rationale: cubic is an AI code-review product, so its code-generation is limited to fixing issues found in review. "Fix with cubic" generates a targeted fix for a review comment and pushes it to the PR branch, and PR comments can be used to trigger fixes. For local changes, the CLI only produces a prompt for a separate coding agent to act on. missing for 10: implementing new features from a plain-language description, fixing arbitrary bugs described by the developer (as opposed to review findings), evidence of multi-file changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of fix quality.
